$comment: Index of pythonchain example chain manifests. Each file under examples/ is a standalone TriG you can also feed to kgx_chain.py from the CLI. Avoids minus / NOT EXISTS / Difference: in a federated multi-KG setting, closed-world negation conflates 'X is not asserted in this KG' with 'X is false everywhere', which breaks the moment the chain spans more than one endpoint. Positive temporal/event filters are used instead.

examples.label: UK Tories elected since 4 July 2024
examples.blurb: Conservative MPs who took a Commons seat at or after the 2024 GE.

examples.label: UK Labour MPs elected since 4 July 2024
examples.blurb: Labour MPs who took a Commons seat at or after the 2024 GE — three filter beads compiled into one fused Execution.

examples.label: UK Reform UK MPs elected since 4 July 2024
examples.blurb: Reform UK's first sizeable Commons cohort — about 5 MPs including Nigel Farage.

examples.label: Women on the Labour benches since 2024
examples.blurb: Stacks the Labour filter and the female-gender filter — the Wikidata SPARQL pattern an intersection of two filters compiles into.

examples.label: UK MPs who studied at Oxford or Cambridge
examples.blurb: Two filter chains merged via kgx:UnionBundle — Oxford alumni ∪ Cambridge alumni among the 2024 intake.

examples.label: UK Labour MPs → fork to birthplaces
examples.blurb: Shared prefix (source → Labour → 2024 onward), then a sibling branch pivots to each MP's town of birth via wdt:P19.

examples.label: UK MPs since 2000 — three readings
examples.blurb: 'Elected since 2000' is ambiguous. The manifest records all three plausible groundings and pins the chosen one.

examples.label: Tory MP, enriched via DDP + Wikidata
examples.blurb: Augment chain: seed from Wikidata, bridge to the UK Parliament DDP for current constituency, then Wikidata again for DOB / birthplace / alma maters.

examples.label: UK Labour MP across Wikidata ↔ Parliament SPARQL
examples.blurb: The same MP joined across two endpoints by rdfs:seeAlso. Models federation without depending on SERVICE.

examples.label: US Senators sworn in since 2023
examples.blurb: Same UK-MP pattern, retargeted at wd:Q4416090 (United States Senator).

examples.label: MEPs of the current European Parliament term
examples.blurb: Members of the European Parliament whose seat started at or after the 2024 election (10th term).

examples.label: Women heads of state taking office since 2010
examples.blurb: wdt:P21 = Q6581072 (female), holding any Q48352 (head of state) position with pq:P580 ≥ 2010.

examples.label: Former heads of state born since 1950
examples.blurb: Anyone who has held wdt:P39 = head-of-state and was born on or after 1950 — a recent generation of leaders.

examples.label: Justices of the UK Supreme Court
examples.blurb: Holders of Q23035001 (Justice of the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom).

examples.label: UN Secretaries-General
examples.blurb: Every holder of Q26197 (Secretary-General of the United Nations) — nine of them, ordered by inauguration.

examples.label: People who served as ministers in two countries
examples.blurb: Identity-bridging Intersection: anyone holding Q83307 (minister) positions in two different country contexts.

examples.label: Nobel laureates born since 1950 who held political office
examples.blurb: wdt:P166 = any Nobel + wdt:P39 = any office, with P569 ≥ 1950 as a positive age band.

examples.label: UK Acts of Parliament mentioning climate
examples.blurb: Q1006782 (Act of Parliament of the UK), with English label containing 'climate'.

examples.label: UK Cabinet ministers who sit in the House of Lords
examples.blurb: Intersection of two positive filters: holds a Q83307 cabinet role AND a current Q18941264 Lords seat.

examples.label: Nobel laureates in Physics
examples.blurb: Anyone awarded wd:Q38104 (Nobel Prize in Physics). Wikidata has portraits for most of them.

examples.label: Discoverers of chemical elements
examples.blurb: People who hold wdt:P61 (discoverer / inventor) of any wd:Q11344 (chemical element).

examples.label: Asteroids named after composers
examples.blurb: wd:Q3863 (asteroid) where the named-after target (wdt:P138) holds wdt:P106 = composer (Q36834).

examples.label: Mountains above 8 000 m
examples.blurb: wd:Q8502 (mountain) with wdt:P2044 (elevation above sea level) ≥ 8000 metres — the fourteen Eight-Thousanders, give or take.

examples.label: Active volcanoes in Japan
examples.blurb: wd:Q8072 (volcano) in country wd:Q17 (Japan), filtered to the active subclass.

examples.label: Hummingbird species endemic to Ecuador
examples.blurb: Members of family wd:Q26447 (Trochilidae) whose endemic-to (wdt:P183) is Ecuador (Q736).

examples.label: Shark species recorded longer than 5 m
examples.blurb: Subclasses of wd:Q35878 (shark) with wdt:P2043 (length) > 5 m. Pacific sleeper, great white, basking, whale shark…

examples.label: Trees confirmed over 1 000 years old
examples.blurb: Individual organisms (wd:Q811979) of class tree, with computed age (today − P571) ≥ 1000 years.

examples.label: Studio albums by The Beatles
examples.blurb: wd:Q1299 (The Beatles) ← performer of wd:Q482994 (album), with release date.

examples.label: Musicians who also publish novels
examples.blurb: Intersection of wdt:P106 = musician AND wdt:P106 = writer, plus at least one published wd:Q571 (book) authored.

examples.label: Eurovision winners, by year
examples.blurb: wd:Q276 (Eurovision Song Contest) wdt:P1346 (winner) by edition. Ranks of Abba.

examples.label: Operas by Mozart
examples.blurb: wd:Q254 (W. A. Mozart) ← composer of wd:Q1344 (opera).

examples.label: Films directed by Christopher Nolan
examples.blurb: wd:Q25191 (Christopher Nolan) ← director of wd:Q11424 (film).

examples.label: Pixar feature films
examples.blurb: wd:Q24336 (Pixar) production-company of wd:Q11424 (film) subclass-of feature film.

examples.label: Booker Prize winners
examples.blurb: wd:Q187100 (Booker Prize) wdt:P1346 → laureate, with the winning novel.

examples.label: Studio Ghibli feature films
examples.blurb: wd:Q174870 (Studio Ghibli) production company of wd:Q11424 (film).

examples.label: Paintings by Vincent van Gogh
examples.blurb: wd:Q5582 (Van Gogh) ← creator of wd:Q3305213 (painting). Tile grid does these justice.

examples.label: Sculptures by Auguste Rodin
examples.blurb: wd:Q30755 (Rodin) ← creator of any wd:Q860861 (sculpture).

examples.label: Roman emperors who reigned 20+ years
examples.blurb: Q842606 (Roman Emperor) holders where (end − start) ≥ 20 years. Augustus, Tiberius, Theodosius II.

examples.label: British monarchs of the House of Tudor
examples.blurb: wd:Q102078 (House of Tudor) members who held an English / Irish monarchy position.

examples.label: Pharaohs of the Eighteenth Dynasty
examples.blurb: wd:Q12554 (18th Dynasty of Egypt) members.

examples.label: UNESCO World Heritage sites in Italy
examples.blurb: wd:Q9259 (UNESCO World Heritage Site) in country wd:Q38 (Italy).

examples.label: London Underground stations on the Northern line
examples.blurb: wd:Q98095 (Northern line) wdt:P81 / inverse to find every station served.

examples.label: Bridges over the River Thames
examples.blurb: wd:Q12280 (bridge) wdt:P177 (crosses) → wd:Q19686 (River Thames). Tower Bridge, etc.

examples.label: Lighthouses on the coast of Scotland
examples.blurb: wd:Q39715 (lighthouse) in admin region Scotland (Q22).

examples.label: PDO cheeses from France
examples.blurb: wd:Q10943 (cheese) in country wd:Q142 (France) with Protected Designation of Origin (Q1404390) status.

examples.label: Trappist breweries (the actual eleven)
examples.blurb: wd:Q41680 (brewery) at a Trappist monastery (Q707261). Chimay, Westvleteren, Rochefort.

examples.label: Capital cities founded before 1000 AD
examples.blurb: Cities that are capitals with inception date < 1000-01-01.

examples.label: Tall ships preserved as museum ships
examples.blurb: wd:Q1075453 (museum ship) of subclass wd:Q170483 (tall ship) — Cutty Sark, USS Constitution, Belém.

examples.label: Programming languages first released since 2010
examples.blurb: wd:Q9143 (programming language) with wdt:P571 (inception) ≥ 2010-01-01. Rust, Crystal, Zig, Carbon.

examples.label: Cocktails on the IBA official list
examples.blurb: wd:Q134271 (cocktail) listed in the International Bartenders Association catalogue — Negronis to Sazeracs.
